title: Senior Application Solution Developer
description:
**Job Description**
Enterprise Engineering designs, builds, and supports Oracle's mission-critical enterprise applications and platforms that power internal business operations. Our teams develop scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions, modernize existing applications, and deliver innovative capabilities using cloud-native technologies.
  
  
As a Software Developer, you will contribute to the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. You will work on enterprise applications, APIs, microservices, and system integrations while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions.
  
  
The role also provides opportunities to work with emerging AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and intelligent automation to enhance enterprise applications and business processes.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong programming skills in Java and/or Python, with solid knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
* Experience developing enterprise applications, REST APIs, microservices, and backend services.
* Good understanding of SQL, relational databases, cloud technologies, and software architecture principles.
* Experience with debugging, unit testing, version control, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-assisted development tools is an added advantage.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable enterprise software applications.
* Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and technical design to deployment and maintenance.
* Develop and enhance backend services, REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations using Java, Python, and modern cloud technologies.
* Troubleshoot complex software defects, optimize application performance, and ensure production stability.
* Improve software architecture, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Develop automated tests, conduct code reviews, and follow software engineering, CI/CD, and DevOps best practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business requirements.
* Contribute to AI/ML and Generative AI initiatives by integrating intelligent capabilities into enterprise applications.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About Us:**
At Oracle, we are transforming healthcare by modernizing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to empower front-line healthcare professionals. Our mission is to enable them to focus more on patient care and less on administrative tasks, achieving peak efficiency with the support of generative AI and modernized applications. By leveraging the power of generative AI and state-of-the-art applications, we aim to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in healthcare delivery. Our approach to modernization includes investing in cutting-edge AI capabilities, advancing user experience, and offering open APIs that enable customers and third parties to develop innovative, integrated solutions. We are dedicated to creating a seamless and intuitive healthcare experience that benefits patients, providers, payers, and the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our Mission: At Oracle Health, we prioritize humans in the healthcare experience—for patients, providers, payers, and the population. We advance healthcare and population-level health by making cutting-edge solutions practical and effective at the practitioner level. Our goal is to enable patients to receive care from anyone, anywhere, on any device by providing practitioners with comprehensive medical information.
  
  
The position is open in Bangalore.
  
  
As a Full stack Software Engineer, you will work with Product/Design during the design phase, author a technical approach to building the features, and breakdown, refine, and deliver the work with your team. The ideal candidate will be passionate, self-motivated, able to multitask effectively, and have strong communication skills. This individual will be autonomous and be expected to contribute to a wide range of high-impact projects across the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure console. Daily tasks include full stack development, testing, CI/CD, participating in scrum activities, and collaboration with Frontend Development, Support, Product Management, and other Service Teams.
  
  
**Technical Qualifications:**
**Required Skills**

* BS degree in Computer Science or related fields or equivalent experience
* 3-5 years of experience in server technology development
* Proficiency in ES6 Javascript, ReactJS, AngularJS, TypeScript
* Expert in multiple languages, including Java, Node.js
* Expert in microservices frameworks such as Spring, Micronaut
* Experience building interfaces, including JSON REST APIs or GraphQL
* Experience with container-based deployment like Docker, Kubernetes
* Experience with test frameworks like Postman/Newman, Junit
* Good understanding of object-oriented JavaScript concepts, HTML5 and CSS along with responsive design
* Desirable: Knowledge of UI/UX design principles, with experience in design tools like Sketch, Figma, or InVision.

**Preferred Skills**

* Very desirable to have AI skills like Prompt engineering, Training models, and LLM.
* Experience with distributed source control, including GIT
* Experience with build tools such as Gradle, Maven
* Experience with continuous deployment tools like Teamcity, Jenkins
* Working experience within a Linux-based environment
* Familiarity with log analysis tools and debugging tools

**Functional Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience with a public cloud platform like AWS, Azure, Oracle
* Experience developing distributed, fault-tolerant applications
* Experience with Agile Methodologies, specifically Scrum
* Experience using ticket tracking systems such as JIRA
* Ability to quickly pick up new languages and technologies
* Self-driven, able to work independently on a project even while the design is evolving
* Strong desire to stay on top of new technologies and services
* Passionate about learning
* Strong communication skills, including cross-team collaboration

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Software Development:**

* Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use.
* Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans.
* Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.
* Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.
* Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.
* Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues.
* Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process.
* Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
* Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.
* Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture.
* Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently.
* Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently.
* Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.
* Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.
* Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.
* Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

* Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

**Problem Solving:**

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet-related tools. * Analyze, debug and fix complex microkernel/Linux issues.
* Continuously drive innovations by working with cross functional teams to address complex problems.

* Work on sustaining existing features.

A minimum of B.E or BTech from a reputed institution in CS/EE with 7+ years of experience is required.

* Excellent C/C++/Python programming, design, problem solving and debugging skills
* Must have strong Networking background.
* Prior experience with Software development on routers, switches is desirable.
* Prior experience with datapath ASICs like Broadcom, Mellanox, Innovium, Barefoot or any other NPU is highly desirable.
* Must be playing a strong technical role in the current position

title: Principal Application Solution Developer
description:
**Job Description**
Designs, develops, and tests complex software solutions. Investigates, diagnoses, and resolves complex and/or challenging technical issues. Performs system maintenance and updates. Customizes software settings to meet specific requirements. Creates project plans and defines scope for medium or mid-term projects. Drives the planning and execution of change management strategies. Documents software implementation requirements and specifications. Drives the implementation process changes to increase efficiency. Leads partnerships with cross-functional teams on projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Implementation and Management – Software Development and Configuration:**

* Designs, develops, and tests complex software solutions.
* Writes code and scripts and advises junior colleagues on coding problems/challenges.
* Debugs and troubleshoots highly complex software issues.
* Drives collaborations with cross-functional teams on software projects.

**Product Implementation and Management – Technical Troubleshooting and Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and resolves complex technical issues.
* Analyzes system logs and error messages.
* Investigates and diagnoses complex and/or challenging software problems.
* Designs and implements solutions to prevent further issues.

**Product Implementation and Management – Technical Support and Maintenance:**

* Provides advanced technical assistance to users or customers.
* Performs system maintenance and updates.
* Monitors and optimizes system performance.
* Responds to support tickets and resolves complex issues.

**Product Implementation and Management – Implementation and Configuration:**

* Configures standard software systems (e.g., turns on features of an application).
* Customizes software settings to meet specific requirements.

**Project Management – Project Planning and Execution:**

* Creates project plans and defines scope for medium or mid-term projects.
* Allocates resources and manages project timelines.
* Tracks project progress and reports on milestones.
* Conducts risk assessments and manages project risks.

**Project Management – Change Management:**

* Assesses the impact of proposed system changes.
* Drives the planning and execution of change management strategies.
* Communicates changes to stakeholders and users.
* Ensures smooth transitions and proactively minimizes disruptions.

**Project Management – Documentation and Reporting:**

* Documents software implementation requirements and specifications.
* Reviews reports on system performance and usage.
* Maintains and helps manage version control.

**Project Management – Continuous Improvement and Process Optimization:**

* Leads process improvement for their team's application area.
* Drives implementation of process changes to increase efficiency.
* Collects and analyzes feedback from users and stakeholders.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives.

**Collaboration – Collaboration and Communication:**

* Leads partnerships with cross-functional teams on projects.
* Helps lead meetings and discussions.
* Provides updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Communicates technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative.
* Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives.
* Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs.
* Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices.
* Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions.
* Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices.
* Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders.
* Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. title: DEVELOPER L4
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

**Do**

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns

At
**AlgoForge Aerospace**

You will architect deterministic, hard-real-time systems where jitter is measured in microseconds. You are responsible for ensuring that sensor fusion, trajectory execution, and abort logic operate flawlessly under extreme launch vibrations and orbital radiation.
  
  
Operational Objectives
  
  
Architect and deploy deterministic, zero-allocation flight software in Modern C++ (17/20) and Rust for the AF-Series launch vehicles.

Design fault-tolerant, autonomous state machines governing pad hold-down release, Max-Q throttling, stage separation, and propulsive landing.
  
  
Write bare-metal drivers for mission-critical sensors (IMU, Star Trackers) and actuators (TVC, pneumatic valves) over CAN FD, RS-422, and Ethernet.
  
  
Support live mission control operations, analyzing high-frequency telemetry data during static fires and orbital launch attempts.

BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with a relentless focus on systems-level programming.
  
  
Expert-level proficiency in C++ or Rust, with a deep, intuitive understanding of memory safety, pointers, and hard-real-time constraints.
  
  
Extensive experience with embedded systems, RTOS (FreeRTOS, RTEMS, VxWorks), and bare-metal microcontroller architectures.
  
  
Familiarity with continuous integration (CI/CD) pipelines for embedded targets and automated HITL test suites.
  
  
A hacker's mindset paired with aerospace rigor—you must be obsessed with wringing every microsecond of performance out of custom flight silicon using JTAG and Logic Analyzers.
  
  
— Deployment Benefits —
  
  
Direct Impact
  
  
Your algorithmic logic directly controls millions of pounds of thrust.
  
  
Custom Silicon
  
  
Run bare-metal code on bespoke, radiation-tolerant flight computers.
  
  
Hardware Loop
  
  
Test your code on physical engines and avionics, not just emulators.
  
  
High Velocity
  
  
Zero red tape. Write code today, hot-fire it on the test stand tomorrow.

title: Lead GNC Engineer
description:
Mission Overview
  
  
At
**AlgoForge Aerospace**
, brute force propulsion is useless without absolute control. As the Lead Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) Engineer, you will architect the brain of the AF-Series launch vehicle.
  
  
Your algorithms will pilot a monolithic structure autonomously through the chaotic atmosphere, managing the highly transient dynamics of Rotating Detonation Engines (RDE). You are responsible for ensuring we thread the needle to orbit with pinpoint accuracy, and execute the supersonic retro-propulsion required to stick the landing.
  
  
Operational Objectives
  
  
Architect robust 6-DOF control laws (TVC & RCS) spanning pad-liftoff, Max-Q, hypersonic reentry, and propulsive booster recovery.
  
  
Design and tune advanced state estimators (Extended/Unscented Kalman Filters) to fuse IMU, GPS, and Star Tracker telemetry in hard-real-time.
  
  
Build aggressive, high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations to validate vehicle survivability and controller stability under extreme aerodynamic dispersions.
  
  
Implement highly optimized guidance algorithms (e.g., convex optimization) for trajectory shaping and precision energy management.
  
  
Own the post-flight data review, interrogating flight telemetry to refine aerodynamic coefficients and anchor your models to reality.
  
  
Mission Prerequisites
  
  
MS/PhD in Aerospace, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering with a relentless focus on Control Theory and Rigid Body Dynamics.
  
  
Deep, intuitive mastery of classical (PID, Root Locus) and modern control architectures (LQR, H-infinity, MPC).
  
  
Uncompromising proficiency in modern C++ for writing deterministic flight code, and Python/MATLAB for rapid mathematical modeling.
  
  
Extensive experience handling orbital mechanics, quaternion math, and highly non-linear aerospace systems.
  
  
A builder's mindset—you must be comfortable running your algorithms on physical Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) test rigs, not just simulations.
  
  
— Deployment Benefits —
  
  
Absolute Autonomy
  
  
Write the logic that commands millions of pounds of thrust.
  
  
Flight Hardware
  
  
Watch your math fly to orbit and return to the landing pad.
  
  
Direct Ownership
  
  
No silos. You write the math, you write the C++, you own the result.
  
  
The Hard Problems
  
  
Solve the unprecedented GNC challenges of RDE-powered ascent.

description:

The Enterprise Middleware Engineer is responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise integration and messaging platforms, including
**GoAnywhere MFT**
,
**AWS ElastiCache**
,
**AWS MSK (Kafka)**
, and
**IBM MQ**
. This role owns platform operations (build, run, and support), automation, incident/problem management, capacity planning, and works closely with application, infrastructure, and security teams to enable secure data movement and event-driven integration at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Administer, configure, and support Go Anywhere MFT (workflows, secure file transfers, keys/certs, user/partner onboarding, scheduling, auditing).
* Operate and maintain AWS MSK (Kafka) clusters (brokers, topics, partitions, replication, retention policies, upgrades/patching, client connectivity).
* Administer IBM MQ environments (Queue Managers, channels, queues, clustering, SSL/TLS, HA/DR, monitoring, performance tuning).
* Manage AWS ElastiCache (Redis/Memcached) including scaling, failover, backups/snapshots, parameter tuning, and performance optimization.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, and disaster recovery readiness (RTO/RPO alignment, failover tests, runbooks).
* Work with application teams on integration patterns, client configuration, connectivity troubleshooting, and best practices.
* Coordinate with InfoSec, Networking, and Cloud Platform teams on secure network paths (VPC, subnets, security groups, NACLs, private endpoints).
* Implement and maintain TLS/mTLS, certificate lifecycle management, encryption standards, secrets management, and secure authentication/authorization.
* Support compliance requirements (audit logging, access reviews, change control, least privilege).
* Partner onboarding/offboarding for MFT and secure integration endpoints

**What We're Looking For**

* 3 - 5 years’ experience in middleware/integration/platform engineering roles supporting production systems.
* Hands-on administration experience (3 - 5 Years) with at least two of the following: Kafka (AWS MSK), GoAnywhere MFT, AWS ElastiCache (Redis/Memcached), IBM MQ
* Strong understanding of messaging/integration concepts: queues/topics, pub-sub, delivery semantics, ordering, retries, dead-letter handling, and back-pressure.
* 3 - 5 Years of experience with Linux administration, networking fundamentals (DNS, TLS, firewalls, ports), and troubleshooting distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of AWS core services and constructs: VPC, IAM, EC2, CloudWatch, security groups, KMS, Secrets Manager/Parameter Store.
* Production support experience including incident management, RCA, and change/release processes.
* Scripting/automation skills (Python/Shell) and familiarity with IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Excellent documentation and communication skills; ability to work cross-functionally

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep expertise in one or more platforms:
* IBM MQ: MQ clustering, multi-instance QM, AMS, advanced channel auth records (CHLAUTH), TLS mutual auth.
* Kafka/MSK: broker sizing, partitioning strategy, consumer lag tuning, ACLs/SASL, schema registry patterns, MirrorMaker/replication.
* GoAnywhere MFT: advanced workflows, API integration, PGP automation, partner lifecycle management, compliance auditing.
* ElastiCache Redis: clustering/sharding, replication groups, persistence strategy (AOF/RDB), latency tuning.
* Experience implementing DR strategies and performing resiliency testing (game days / failover drills).
* Certifications (nice-to-have): AWS Certified Sy sops/DevOps, IBM MQ certification, Confluent/Kafka training, security fundamentals.

title: RF / Telemetry Engineer
description:
Mission Overview
  
  
At
**AlgoForge Aerospace**
, data is our most critical payload. As an RF & Telemetry Engineer, you own the vital, invisible umbilical cord between the AF-Series launch vehicle and Mission Control.
  
  
This isn't building a consumer Wi-Fi router. You are responsible for ensuring high-fidelity RF links survive the extreme EMI, acoustic shock, and plasma blackout of a Rotating Detonation Engine (RDE) ascent. From the custom Node 2 Flight Computer to the Node 3 Ground Station, you guarantee that our telemetry stream never drops.
  
  
Operational Objectives
  
  
Take absolute ownership of RF link budgets, guaranteeing unbroken command uplinks and high-bandwidth telemetry downlinks under extreme orbital dynamics.
  
  
Design, characterize, and aggressively tune custom antenna architectures (433MHz/915MHz LoRa, S-Band) using VNAs to eliminate dead zones.
  
  
Develop ultra-low-latency, bare-metal C++ firmware to serialize, compress, and transmit high-frequency sensor streams (IMU, load cells) with zero packet loss.
  
  
Fortify flight avionics against catastrophic EMI/RFI generated by the VORTEX-1 engine's ignition relays, high-voltage servos, and plasma exhaust.
  
  
Bridge the hardware-software divide, piping raw receiver streams directly into our Next.js Mission Director Dashboard for real-time Launch Director decisions.
  
  
Mission Prerequisites
  
  
BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, or Telecommunications with a proven track record of shipping physical RF hardware.
  
  
Deep, intuitive mastery of RF circuit design, impedance matching, Software Defined Radios (SDR), and rigorous link budget analysis.
  
  
Uncompromising embedded C/C++ programming skills, specifically pushing microcontrollers and high-speed buses (SPI/I2C) to their absolute limits.
  
  
Expert understanding of complex modulation schemes (LoRa, FSK, QPSK), forward error correction (FEC), and packet framing protocols.
  
  
A relentless troubleshooting mindset—you must be able to hunt down microsecond latency spikes and parasitic RF noise using spectrum analyzers.
  
  
— Deployment Benefits —
  
  
The Absolute Umbilical
  
  
If your link drops, we go blind. You hold the vehicle's lifeline.
  
  
Antenna to API
  
  
Own the entire data pipeline, from bare-metal RF propagation to JSON payload ingestion.
  
  
Hostile Environments
  
  
Design electronics that thrive in the brutal acoustic environment of a detonation engine.
  
  
Ground Truth
  
  
The telemetry you secure is the only proof that our physics models actually work.

description:

**Job Title: Software Engineer (III) - Core Engineer III**
**Location: Chennai**
**Work Type: Hybrid (4 Days work From Office)**
**Position Description**
Module Lead – Software Engineer (Integration/Platform)
  
  

* The client is seeking a Module Lead – Software Engineer to join our Integration/Platform team, which powers critical communications across the client's Credit.
* In this individual contributor role, you will design and build event-driven, scalable, reliable, fault-tolerant, and resilient solutions within our platform ecosystem.
* This is more than a traditional backend engineering role. We are looking for an engineer who operates at the intersection of software engineering, AI-driven automation, and enterprise problem-solving, partnering with technology and product stakeholders to transform business requirements into practical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable, event-driven integration and platform solutions.
* Collaborate with technology and product teams to understand business needs and user journeys, translating them into technical solutions.
* Operate as a Forward Deployed Engineer, working directly with stakeholders to scope, prototype, and rapidly deliver proof-of-concepts using a fail-fast approach.
* Build and integrate AI agents into enterprise workflows using the GCP and Claude ecosystems.
* Embrace a Human-Led, Agent-Assisted model, partnering with AI agents to accelerate engineering delivery and productivity.
* Apply DevSecOps practices, including monitoring, alerting, observability, and operational dashboards.
* Continuously identify opportunities to modernize, automate, and improve engineering processes through AI-enabled solutions. What We're Looking For Mindset & Ways of Working
* Self-motivated engineer who is genuinely AI-transformation ready.
* Comfortable working as a forward-deployed engineer, balancing technology expertise, stakeholder engagement, and solution delivery.
* Open to co-developing solutions alongside AI agents.
* Strong builder mindset with a focus on rapid experimentation, prototyping, and learning.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and Node.js.
* Hands-on experience building and integrating AI agents using GCP and/or Claude ecosystem tools.
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture and SOAP/REST APIs.
* Experience developing applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Expertise across testing disciplines, including Unit, Integration, Regression, UAT, and Load Testing.
* Hands-on experience with TDD, JUnit, and Selenium.
* Familiarity with code quality and security tools such as 42Crunch, SonarQube, Checkmarx, or equivalent.
* Strong DevSecOps experience, including monitoring, alerting, and observability practices.

* The ideal candidate has experience building AI agents, skills, and workflow automation solutions that solve real business problems.
* This role is best suited for an integration specialist with experience leveraging existing models, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to deliver practical, production-grade solutions.
* This is not a model-development or ML research role.

**Qualifications**

* B.E., B.Tech., M.C.A., or equivalent technical degree.
* 5+ years of hands-on software development experience.
* 3+ years of experience with microservices architecture and SOAP/REST APIs.
* Demonstrated experience building solutions on GCP.
* Proven experience with TDD using JUnit and Selenium.
* Experience with code quality and security tools such as 42Crunch, SonarQube, and Checkmarx.

**Skills Required**

* Dynatrace, React, Microservices, SOAP, GitHub, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, GCP, REST APIs, AIPGEE

* AI Engineer III
* Full Stack Engineer (AI-Augmented) Exp: Prac. in full-stack dev (web/backend/mobile) — working knowledge in 2+ areas
* Hands-on exp. w/ React.js / modern JS frontend frameworks (React preferred; Angular/Vue acceptable)
* Hands-on exp. w/ Java + Spring Boot (MVC, JDBC, Cloud) for backend/APIs
* Prac. exp. w/ HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive UI design
* 1+ yr prac. exp. w/ AI-native coding tool (Copilot/Cursor/Claude Code)
* Working know. of GCP or equiv. cloud platform
* Basic know. of token/context optimization (.cursorignore, scoped referencing)
* Exp. w/ REST/SOAP APIs, CI/CD (GitHub, Jenkins), TDD (JUnit/Selenium/Jest)

**Experience Required**

* Engineer III Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang.
* 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development

**Education Required**

* Bachelor's Degree

**Education Preferred**

* Master's Degree

description:

FEA Simulation
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA

**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
We are seeking a skilled CFD - Physics AI Simulation Engineer to join our Physical AI practice, focused on building next-generation physics simulation capabilities for industrial clients. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on expertise in computational fluid dynamics and thermal simulation, combined with applied proficiency in Physics AI techniques - Reduced Order Modeling (ROM), surrogate modeling, and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), to transform high-fidelity simulation outputs into fast, deployable AI models at client scale.
  
  
In this role, you will run parametric CFD and continuous process simulations, build Physics AI pipelines that convert simulation data into real-time predictive models, and contribute to a tool-agnostic platform that serves clients across industries.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities:
  
  
Architect simulation solutions across multi-physics domains (mechanical, thermal, fluid, electrical), with orchestration of cross-domain and discrete-event simulations.
  
  
Lead the development and execution of advanced CFD, multiphysics, and electromagnetic/electro-thermal simulations at both component and system levels, including turbulence, multiphase flows, conjugate heat transfer, fluid-structure interaction, and electromagnetic field modeling. Ensure accurate physics representation, coupling strategies and scaling workflows through automation, HPC, and cloud deployment.
  
  
Implement cross-domain and hybrid simulations, combining discrete-event modeling for factory workflows with physics-based models for material, fluid, and thermal processes.
  
  
Design and execute parametric simulation studies using structured Design of Experiments (DOE), sampling strategies (Latin Hypercube, Sobol), and output extraction protocols to generate Physics AI training datasets.
  
  
Develop and integrate ROMs, Surrogate models and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for fluid and thermal problems embedding governing equations (Navier-Stokes, heat equation, species transport) as physics constraints in neural network training loss, enabling physically consistent predictions from sparse simulation data.
  
  
Develop virtual sensor and derived variable models: extract ROM field predictions at specific spatial locations to simulate real-time sensor readings. Compute derived engineering KPIs, including remaining useful life (RUL), energy efficiency, yield uniformity from ROM outputs using physics-based and data-driven methods.
  
  
Champion co-simulation architectures, surrogate modeling, and tool integration across commercial software (ANSYS, COMSOL, Abaqus) and scripting environments (Python, MATLAB, Modelica).
  
  
Provide technical leadership and mentorship, guiding engineering teams in scalable simulation, best practices and architectural patterns.
  
  
Actively lead and participate in sales pursuits and pre-sales engagements, with responsibility for new project wins. This will involve multiple discussions and presentation of our capability and solutions to potential clients and other Accenture stakeholders/leaders.
  
  
Active participation and leadership in driving industry related thought leadership activities like patents, authoring whitepapers/POVs, proof of concepts, conference/academia presentations, capability presentations etc.
  
  
Work with global clients and cross-functional teams in a multicultural and distributed environment.
  
  
Professional and Technical Skills:
  
  
Must Have Skills:
  
  
Hands-on CFD simulation expertise with at least one primary solver - Ansys Fluent, OpenFOAM, or STAR-CCM+ covering mesh generation, boundary condition setup, turbulence modeling (k-e, k-w SST, LES), multiphase flow (VOF, Eulerian), conjugate heat transfer, and species transport for industrial-scale problems.
  
  
Strong numerical foundations in finite volume method, discretisation schemes, pressure-velocity coupling (SIMPLE, PISO), solver stability, and mesh quality assessment with the ability to diagnose and resolve convergence issues independently.
  
  
Applied knowledge of Physics AI methods: Reduced Order Modeling (ROM) using POD/SVD, surrogate modeling (Gaussian Process, Gradient Boosting, Neural Network), and DOE sampling strategies (LHS, Sobol, CCD) with the ability to connect CFD simulation outputs to Physics AI training pipelines.
  
  
Proficiency in Python for simulation automation and Physics AI development: NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, h5py (HDF5 storage), Matplotlib, and PyVista (3D field visualisation). Familiarity with PyFluent, PyFOAM, or equivalent CFD Python APIs for programmatic solver control and result extraction.
  
  
Ability to extract, structure, and manage large field datasets (full nodal arrays: velocity, pressure, temperature) from CFD solver result files - cas/dat, VTK, RST, HDF5 formats - for Physics AI model training.
  
  
Creating digital twins, performing physics-based simulation, rendering RTX environments, or synthetic data workflows for real-time industrial applications.
  
  
Cloud engineering background, including automation, orchestration, and deployment of simulation pipelines in scalable environments.
  
  
Experience with manufacturing, industrial automation, automotive, or aerospace sectors.
  
  
Good to Have Skills:
  
  
Exposure to Ansys Twin Builder, FMI/FMU standard, or digital twin integration - deploying ROM as an FMU for system-level simulation or real-time inferencing in an operational environment.
  
  
Experience in scripting and automation, e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB, Modelica.
  
  
Background in digital twin development for factory planning, robotics simulation, or predictive maintenance.
  
  
Knowledge of NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim.
  
  
Familiarity with FMI/FMU, OpenModelica, OpenUSD, or robotics simulation standards.
  
  
Exposure to AI/ML-driven simulation workflows, Physics-informed ML, surrogate modeling, generative AI tools for model generation and behavior prediction.
  
  
Additional Info:
  
  
This position is based at Bengaluru, Pune
  
  
Candidate should have 8-10 years of experience
  
  
Bachelor s or master s in engineering, Physics
